description: Unified per-strike exposure sheet: GEX, DEX, VEX, CHEX, and DAG in one response with chain totals, Line-in-the-Sand inflection strike, gamma peaks, and OPEX/triple-witching flags. Use to scan all greeks at every strike in a single call.

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

expiration.description: Optional expiration date YYYY-MM-DD. Triggers OPEX/triple-witching flags.

min_oi.description: Optional minimum open interest threshold — drops strikes with call_oi + put_oi < min_oi (e.g. 100).

name: get_exposure_sheet
title: Exposure Sheet
